Subject: Vendor procurement: privacy declarations + PO path (Helium Health)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for moving this forward. To keep procurement and security aligned, I’m sending the items Redwood needs to complete vendor activation and PO issuance: 

1) Master DPA (attached PDF, latest internal draft). We prefer DocuSign for signature; I’ll send a link once procurement confirms billing details.
2) SOC 2 summary link (hosted): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/2027-soc2-summary.html — this is the current third-party audit summary (scope: prod infra).
3) Subprocessor inventory (attached CSV) — please confirm any objections to classes of subprocessors listed.
4) PO template (attached) and our preferred net terms are listed below.

Requests / ask list:
- Could you confirm the PO billing address and remit-to details for Helium Health by EOD Friday?
- Who should we expect the signed DPA from — legal@heliumhealth.com or procurement@heliumhealth.com? We’ll route DocuSign accordingly.
- Any special tax or W9-equivalent forms required for your AP team?

I’ve cc’d Ben (procurement) and Irene (security) so they can pick up PO formatting and subprocessor questions respectively.

Attachments: DPA_Redwood_v1.2.pdf; SOC2_2027_summary.html (link included); subprocessors_helium.csv; purchase_order_template.docx

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Laura Chen <laura@heliumhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliumhealth.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor procurement: privacy declarations + PO path (Helium Health)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear checklist. I reviewed the SOC2 summary and the subprocessor list briefly — looks standard from our side. A couple notes:

- Our AP team requires the following fields on the PO: company legal name (Helium Health, Inc.), remit-to address, and a TAX ID. I’ve copied procurement@heliumhealth.com to provide the TAX ID securely.
- For the DPA, our legal prefers to sign via DocuSign; please send the envelope to contracts@heliumhealth.com.
- Quick question from our security team: can you confirm whether logs for API requests are retained longer than 90 days by default, or do you offer a 90-day retention configuration for SaaS tenants? If possible, Irene can follow up with a narrow technical question.

We’ll aim to return a signed PO within 7 business days once we have the DocuSign DPA and the PO template populated.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Partnerships
Helium Health
laura@heliumhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-2099

Laura / Naomi —

I’m Ben on Redwood procurement. Quick logistics:

- Attached is our purchase_order_template.docx (fillable). Please populate with Helium Health legal name and TAX ID and return as a scanned PDF as required by your AP workflow.
- Redwood standard payment term for new vendor activation is Net 30; we can consider Net 45 for enterprise contracts but that will need finance sign-off (flagged).
- PO number format: RH-YYYY-#####. If you need a sample PO backfilled for reference, I can provide one.

Laura — if procurement@heliumhealth.com can send the TAX ID to procurement@redwood.ai (or upload to the shared Drive folder), we’ll draft the initial PO and route to your AP contacts.

Laura — thanks for the quick turn. Next steps from Redwood:

- I will initiate the DocuSign envelope for DPA_Redwood_v1.2.pdf and address it to contracts@heliumhealth.com tomorrow morning (expect the link in your inbox).
- Ben will prepare a draft PO after your AP team supplies the TAX ID and remit address; Ben, please set the template to Net 30 unless we hear a reason to escalate.
- Irene: will follow up on the retention question. Irene, please ask for a short clarification on default API log retention and any available tenant-level controls.

If Helium can confirm the remit address and TAX ID in the next 48 hours, we can have the PO and DPA signed and the account activated within 7 business days. Appreciate the partnership.
